name: Build an outcome-based roadmap and write the update
why: Runs the roadmap and stakeholder update steps end to end.

name: Check demand for your idea, then run one cheap test
why: The discovery step: evidence first, then one cheap test before any spec.

name: Set a six-week product bet and screen requests against it
why: Fixed-time bets and request screening, as in the prioritise-and-roadmap skill.

name: Launch a smaller product on the date you set
why: Cuts a launch to fit a date; pairs with the release and readout workflow.

name: Cut your product line to the few that pay
why: Applies the same must, later, never thinking to a whole product line.

name: Weekly product feedback triager
why: Turns weekly feedback into themes that feed problem briefs.

name: Yes-later-no request sorter
why: Sorts incoming requests into yes, later or no with reasons.

name: Feature request no writer
why: Writes the kind reply that goes with a declined request.

name: Two-version result reader
why: Reads an A/B result; use with the experiment readout prompt's data checks.

name: MVP experiment planner
why: Plans the first-version test and its pass and fail results.

name: Customer discovery interview planner
why: Plans discovery interviews before a problem brief.

name: Prepare an AI pilot go decision
why: Checks an AI pilot's evidence before launch; pairs with the AI feature launch skill.
